image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a Nile crocodile partially submerged in murky brown water. The view focuses on the dorsal surface of the head and upper back, showcasing the rough, armored texture of the skin and the prominent bony ridges (osteoderms) running down the spine. The snout is visible at the bottom, tapering into the water, while the top of the head and eyes are near the surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the snout tapers to a distinct point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and the jawline is largely submerged or obscured by the angle; individual teeth and their interlocking nature are not clearly visible for verification.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye bumps are visible on the top of the head, the resolution and water refraction prevent clear identification of vertical slit pupils or the nictitating membrane.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The very tip of the snout is submerged or cut off by the frame edge, making the nostrils invisible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible section of the body shows heavy, plate-like armor typical of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct, raised longitudinal ridges of osteoderms run parallel down the center of the back, matching the biological description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of muddy browns and greys, and the texture is visibly rough, knobby, and organic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal (top-down) view; the belly/ventral side is completely occluded by the body and water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in this specific crop/frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the frame.

alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates excellent class conformance for the visible anatomy. All testable checkpoints regarding the dorsal armor, osteoderm arrangement, and snout shape are passed with high fidelity. The texture is biologically accurate. Several checkpoints were marked untestable due to framing (no limbs/tail) or occlusion (teeth/eyes), but there are no contradictions in the visible data.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. The water interaction, including refraction around the snout and surface tension bubbles, appears physically correct. Skin textures are consistent and sharp without melting or structural collapse.
